decisions.reason: As a 2023 flagship close to the core dosimetry and QA business and still prominently featured on the home page, it remains a strategic option with low apparent reason to exit.
The oncology risk management software extends the firm's established integrated QA workflow and, with only two years on the market, its option value still outweighs likely carrying costs.
This 2024 CT image quality phantom fits the firm's move into converged imaging QA and is too new for uncertainty about market potential to be considered resolved.

Although this mammography phantom is more distant from the firm's historical focus, it is a recent and relatively low-carry-cost probe into imaging QA, so management would likely keep it while learning continues.

This full field mammography test phantom is also distant from the core portfolio and faces stronger portfolio competition, but as a fresh 2024 launch its commercial signal is still too incomplete to justify withdrawal now.
As a 2024 flagship product line aligned with the firm's stated direction in medical imaging QA, it has high strategic importance and substantial remaining option value.
